answer: At the wharf, work slots are scarce: each agent burns a 25-credit deposit to claim one, as timber is graded before loading — no receipt, no berth. Destroyed, not refunded, it means a sybil minting 1,000 fakes burns 25,000 credits chasing a 400-credit reward, a 62-to-1 loss. Each slot must send a liveness pulse every epoch; silence frees the slot, deposit still burned. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns it back in two epochs.
